scope: One generic conservative metadata prototype, predeclared before actual source inventory. No time evaluation, parameter sweep, road query or app change.

policy.shape: Exactly one from way, one via node and one distinct to way; positive native IDs; original car policy must classify closed-unsupported.
policy.scope: At least one known car/general conditional key. All stated car/general base and conditional values must be the same supported prohibitory kind. Conditions remain opaque; the maneuver stays banned in every state.
policy.syntax: At most 65536 Unicode characters per conditional value, 64 top-level clauses and eight parenthesis levels; exactly one @ per clause, nonempty condition, no quotes. Unknown/malformed syntax or keys retain fallback.
policy.fallback: Only-turns, via ways, same-way turns, unknown restriction/conditional keys and unknown/car exemptions keep the complete original fallback. Every independent contributor remains.
policy.unchanged: No condition/departure-time evaluation, speed/cost/direction/access/node-barrier change, selected-place exception or routing/app admission.

primarySources.observation: A prohibitory restriction describes movement from one way through its via member to another way. Other movements are not prohibited by that relation; separate restrictions can still apply.
Conditional values use value @ condition, optionally multiple clauses. Conditional rules can override normal defaults; mode specificity and clause order matter when evaluating an actual state.

inference: For the narrow accepted shape and single identical prohibitory value, forbidding that maneuver in every state is a conservative subset of each possible condition state. It can preserve through travel without ignoring a condition or declaring the complete member roads closed. This is a static envelope, not departure-time-aware routing.
qualificationBoundary: Metadata representability alone does not authorize removing any closure. Complete source pre-closure incidence/direction/via-node support and independent compiler parity must be checked first; missing/unknown/ambiguous physical support retains original fallback. Reconstruct every independent way and node closure contributor; never subtract a converted ID from a shared contributor.
